'''Josh Smith''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 104 from Saint Joseph, MI.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115082800/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/bespin.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
